statements.markdown: Our baseline is constructed from Ref.
statements.note: Rubin et al.'s Table 2 supplies $\lambda=1{,}744{,}784.42$ Ha, $24{,}980$ Toffolis per walk step and $5{,}650$ logical qubits. Appendix G.2 recomputes the query count at the ten evolution times. This gives about $1.20\times10^{14}$ Toffolis over 500 runs. The full-size QSP row in Rubin et al.'s Table 3 reports $9.960\times10^{16}$.

statements.markdown: a block-encoding cost of $C_{\mathrm{BE}}=2.498\times 10^{4}$ Toffolis per walk step
statements.note: The block-encoding cost is charged once per query. The size of $\lambda$ determines the leading query count. The $22.53$ Ha per electron–proton or electron–electron pair is a sum over nonzero momentum transfers. The $218\cdot216$ electron–proton pairs and $\binom{218}{2}$ electron pairs account for about $91.4\%$ of the normalization.
